About Recess Pickleball
Recess Pickleball is a startup based in Austin, TX. We are a rapidly growing lifestyle brand that manufactures and sells pickleball equipment. We have a bold vision to be THE brand in the fastest growing sport in America. We are a small and growing team that enjoys staying active, trying new things, and having a good time. We are looking for ambitious and scrappy self-starters to join our team.

sections.heading: The Job
sections.content:
We are always looking to connect with individuals who are excited by our brand, passionate about startups, and interested in learning more about opportunities at Recess. If you would like to be a part of building the next big lifestyle brand, we want to hear from you!
Share your resume, cover letter, and/or work samples and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
